title: TalentHub — Remote Talent Agency
description: A landing page for a staffing agency that places vetted remote professionals with startups. The hero is a shared-hours planner: drag your working day and see, city by city, how many hours you overlap and how many vetted people fit. Includes a talent bench, a swipeable shortlist, a comparison table and per-hire pricing.
features: Draggable working-day block that snaps to 30 minutes and recomputes overlap for six cities
Spring-animated overlap bars and a rolling match count
Bubble cluster of available people per discipline
Swipeable candidate shortlist, folder peek and onboarding checklist
Per-hire pricing with a rolling odometer
Hydration-safe, reduced-motion aware, no remote assets
